name: framelink
description: Read Figma frames from your own machine and rebuild them as pixel-perfect code. A local bridge, a compact outline format, and a screenshot-free visual diff.

interface.shortDescription: Figma to pixel-perfect frontend code, locally.
interface.longDescription: Reads your Figma selection through a local bridge as a compact outline or CSS, then checks your build against it with a visual diff. Nothing leaves your machine.
defaultPrompt: Build my current Figma selection and verify it against the design.
Check the FrameLink connection to Figma.
